analysis.reason: RSI가 42.7로 과매도 구간에 진입했으며, MACD 히스토그램은 -21.8827로 악화가 지속되고 있다. 5일 연속 하락 후 반등 시도를 하고 있으나, 거래량은 5일 평균 대비 0.65배로 위축되어 있어 추세 전환 신뢰도가 낮다.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI is at 42.7, entering oversold territory, and the MACD histogram is worsening at -21.8827. The price is attempting a rebound after 5 consecutive down days, but the trading volume is subdued at 0.65x the 5-day average, lowering confidence in a trend reversal.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position vs SMA100/200($1584.07/$1387.81) — Strong mid-to-long-term trend
· 52-week position (71.8%) + Current price level is about 18% below historical highs
[Momentum Indicators]

· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-7.3758→-21.8827) — Worsening, confirming bearish trend
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Lower Band $1580.24) — Approaching lower band, 17.98% band width suggests potential for increased volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
